d: A very elegant living room in Magda's house, in Paris. In the right corner of a large window-green window, beyond which you can see a part of the Tuilleries in full twilight. The entrance door, very large and decorated with a rich courtyard, is a little to the left, in the background wall. On the left -in the foreground - a small door leads to the boudoir. You can access it for a small staircase of a few steps, with wooden railing. In the bottom, on the right -first floor - a marble fireplace surmounted by a large mirror. At the fireplace two armchairs and a small low table. Many other small tables, armchairs, chairs, sofas, are distributed here and there with art and with taste. At the veranda, a screen. On the walls tapestries and precious prints. On the furniture ninnoli and flowers. On the right - half-room- a tail piano covered by a rich brocade. On the floor there is a ceiling of red roses. On the vault on the vault at the vault of a vase of roses.

From Bullier. You go down to the hall from a rich staircase to the left. In the hall is a large crowd of crowds, a mixed crowd of Students, Artists, Mondane, Adventors, Curious. Some are seated here and there at tables variously arranged. Others in groups or suns, go down the stairway. Still others go up the one leading to the loggia. In the back the garden, illuminated, by small white and opaque lamps. In the left wall are two large arched windows covered with curtains, over which is the road going up. On the tables, in the hall, in the loggia flower pots in great profusion. Some floraie wander among the crowd that enters, goes out, sits, rises, calls, gives orders, confusely. The Waiters go and come from one table to the other.

A small pavilion above a hill that degrades on a grassy area. In front of the pavilion a small terrace where are a table and some garden chairs. It crosses a creek cut by a wooden bridge. Here and there thin trees and in bloom. In the bottom is an open wall in the middle: on the ivy wall and climbing roses. Beyond the shaved foliage of the olive trees through which you can see a strip of the Côte d'Azur. From this opening you go down to the sea. It is the advanced afternoon of a magnificent spring day. Flights of swallows in the distant sky. Magda and Ruggero, at the table on which the tea was brought, seem to savor the intimate sweetness of the hour and the landscape.
